name: minimalism-ui
description: Minimal, Typora-style writing UI for Obsidian — hides distractions, keeps the sidebar focused on note status, and puts all attention on your content. Clean, zen, distraction-free interface.

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-theme-assets.mjs && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Lucas
